source.title: The Ruins of Andorhal
source.description:
Remains such as the one you carry tend to have mysterious properties. Some particularly powerful relics may even seem sentient or have a personality at times, particularly in proximity to individuals and places closely tied to their living selves.

If this truly is Uther's blood, there is a chance it may react when near to the place Uther died. Explore the town and see what happens.
source.objective: Take the Blood of the Lightbringer and explore Andorhal.
source.progress: Have you explored Andorhal yet? Did the blood react in any way?
source.completion: So there is no doubt then, the blood is authentic. What you have there is a treasure, <class>. Take care and protect it with your life.
